infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Virtual Try-On needs camera access to take photos for trying on garments. Your photos are processed locally and never shared without your permission.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Virtual Try-On needs photo library access to let you select photos for trying on garments. Your photos remain private and secure.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Virtual Try-On needs permission to save your try-on results to your photo library. You can share or keep these images privately.
